Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) Thursday, November 19, 2026 🚨

$TTWO combining massive launch sales with years of recurring spending through GTA Online.

text:
No Rockstar statement names PS5 Pro as locked to 30 fps at launch. Rob Nelson said current console builds run at 30 fps (reports include Pro from the studio visit questions), with any 60 fps option still needing tech team review.

No public footage or hands-on of GTA 6 on PS5 Pro, with or without PSSR 2.0. All official material is base PS5.

No official confirmation of multiple modes, specific ray tracing, or HDR details for the Pro version beyond the Enhanced badge.
